verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's evidence pack covers analytics, reporting, session replay, exports, and an MCP server for querying data, but there is no evidence of a rules/trigger engine that lets users define event-based conditions to automatically fire actions (e.g., alerts, webhooks, workflows). The closest mentions (docs-47 'agents monitor and tell you what to do next', docs-36 feature-flag API) describe passive insight surfacing or manual flag assignment, not user-authored automated triggers.
